sources.title: Crown FW-3 Distortion Wah Volume | Effects Database
sources.excerpt: Effects Database identifies the Crown FW-3 Distortion Wah Volume as a vintage multi-effect pedal from Applied Audio's OEM line. The exact model combines distortion, wah, and volume functions in a treadle-operated enclosure, with separate controls and footswitches for the effect sections. The page describes an analog transistor design, a cast-metal chassis, a steel treadle, and battery power. It also identifies the Crown version within a larger family of related Applied-branded FW-3 pedals.
